name: jlcpcb-2layer-2oz

quotes.minimum_via_annular_ring_mm: ① Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size.
quotes.minimum_via_drill_mm: Min. Via hole size/diameter: 0.15/0.25mm (0.1mm/0.2mm only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required)
quotes.minimum_copper_to_edge_mm: Routed: ① Copper clearance from routed board edges: ≧0.2 mm
quotes.minimum_annular_ring_mm: PTH annular ring, 2-layer: 2 oz: 0.254 mm or above
quotes.minimum_pth_drill_mm: Drill Diameter: 2-layer: 0.15 – 6.3 mm (0.1mm microvias only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required)
quotes.maximum_pth_drill_mm: Drill Diameter: 2-layer: 0.15 – 6.3 mm (0.1mm microvias only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required)
quotes.minimum_pth_hole_to_copper_mm: PTH to Track: 0.28mm (0.35mm is recommended, minimum 0.28mm)
quotes.minimum_silk_line_width_mm: Legend, Minimum Line Width: ≥0.15mm. Characters width less than 0.15mm will be unidentifiable.
quotes.minimum_smd_pad_to_pad_mm: SMD pad to pad clearance (different nets) 0.15mm

derivations.minimum_via_annular_ring_mm: Via ring = (diameter - hole) / 2 = 0.1 mm / 2 = 0.05 mm (the stated minimum, not the 0.15 mm preferred margin).
derivations.minimum_silk_text_height_mm: 40 mil = 1.016 mm; JLC states 1.0 mm for this row, which is used.

notes: Ring limits are the vendor's absolute minimum; JLC's 'recommended' figure is kept in the quote but not enforced.
The 0.254 mm 2 oz figure is JLC's PTH (component-hole) ring; vias have their own rule (diameter >= hole + 0.1 mm), which is the via ring limit here.
Hole spacing: via/via pairs use 'Via Hole-to-Hole Spacing'; every other pair uses 'Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing'. JLC does not state a via-to-pad hole rule.
Holes above the PTH maximum are not impossible: 'Holes with diameter ≥ 6.3 mm are CNC routed from a smaller drilled hole.' Treat a DRILL_SIZE maximum finding as a process change, not a hard reject.
P2 checks minimum track width; track spacing is the fab pass's copper clearance (below).
Copper spacing, hole-to-copper and silkscreen text limits are applied by zapote-check's fab pass in KiCad's own DRC (a copy of the board with only these rules), not by the P2 geometry rules.

Not covered: 'Pad To Silkscreen 0.15mm', the solder-mask bridge, and silkscreen graphic line width (JLC scopes the legend line width to characters, and KiCad has no custom-rule constraint for graphics; minimum_silk_line_width_mm is checked on text strokes). Pad and footprint local clearances are cleared on the fab pass's copy, since KiCad lets them override every custom rule; PTH-to-track uses the 0.28 mm minimum, not the 0.35 mm recommendation.

JLC's SMD pad-to-pad row (0.15 mm) governs pad pairs, after the general spacing; 'Min. 0.09 mm locally for BGA pads' is not modelled (stricter is kept). JLC states pad-to-track for 1 oz only ('Pad to track clearance (1oz) 0.1mm'), so this profile uses its track spacing.
